central_claim: The published FET-fusion -> impaired-ATM -> compensatory-ATR-dependency hypothesis is internally consistent in public data but does not transfer to EMC as an EMC-specific finding: EMC's structural precondition splits by fusion type (met for type 2, not met for the commonest, type 1), the DepMap line long treated as 'the one real EMC line' is recorded as not carrying an EWSR1 fusion, the EMC tumour transcriptome signature grades WEAK (generic proliferation only, on two independent series), the CRISPR dependency instrument is saturated and blind, and drug-response tracking of the mechanism passes only 1 of 4 tests -- so the document reports an assessment, not a finding, with no efficacy/safety/therapeutic-window/clinical-readiness claim made anywhere.
